note: config interview prints the policy, writes codexclaw.json, and rejects an unknown policy with exit 2.

steps.stdout:
Usage:
  cxc config interview [off|new-unit|always]

  off       only an explicit 'interview' / '인터뷰' request opens the Interview
  new-unit  also open it on the first plan request of a new unit (default)
  always    open it on every plan request

The Interview is advisory: it never changes the PABCD phase, and goal mode always suppresses it.
